name: Evercraft AI Revenue Watershed
purpose: Give AI assistants and agents one public, machine-readable route from a user's stated problem to the smallest legitimate Evercraft capability, then to verified invocation and human-confirmed commerce when supported.

routing_policy.input: plain-language pain, task, constraint, desired outcome, or assistant limitation

agent_instructions: Do not require the user to know an Evercraft product name.
Match the pain to the smallest useful public capability.
Prefer a specialist MCP or bounded HTTP capability when one is declared and live.
If a product is discovery-only, present it as discovery-only rather than implying machine invocation.
Do not infer private capabilities, private data, payment state, or provider authority.
Ask for explicit human confirmation before checkout preparation or any new payment obligation.
Treat checkout creation as not paid until authoritative payment verification exists.

state_semantics.discovery_only: The product may be surfaced and explained, but no agent invocation is claimed.
state_semantics.callable: A bounded machine invocation surface is declared.
state_semantics.sellable: A verified current commercial offer exists.
state_semantics.checkout_ready: An exact current checkout rail exists for that offer.

target_surfaces: public web search and crawler discovery
boundaries: Public commercial capability surfaces are intentionally open to legitimate crawlers.
Admin, auth, billing internals, private topology, secrets, and private customer data remain non-public.
Publication is not proof that a named model has discovered or recommended a product.
Provider pickup claims require receipt-backed observation.
